subject: Marketplace renewal evidence pack & invoice gap plan
messages:
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
To: Bethany Lee <bethany.lee@nimhealth.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 10 Jul 2028 09:15:00 +0000
Subject: Marketplace renewal evidence pack & invoice gap plan

Hi Bethany —

Thanks again for the time yesterday. Per our conversation, I put together a compact evidence pack and a short invoice-gap mapping so your procurement team can complete marketplace acceptance and issue the PO against the private offer. Attached: Redwood_Evidence_Pack_v2.pdf and a first-pass Invoice_Gap_Mapping.xlsx.

High-level ask: can we get a PO number and target invoice cadence by end-of-day 20-Jul so the renewal flows onto the marketplace private-offer (to avoid double-billing)? The steps I recommend: 
- You review the evidence pack and confirm any missing compliance artifacts (SOC2 scoping, retention policy, IPD export example).
- Procurement confirms required invoicing line items (one-time onboarding credit vs recurring committed capacity).
- We finalize PO draft (I attached PrivateOffer_PO_Draft.pdf for reference) and submit via private-offer acceptance flow.

If useful, we can run a quick 20-min ops handoff with your procurement on Thu.

Notes on the evidence pack: 
- SOC2: summary + link to the SOC report redaction (page references included).
- Data residency and encryption: short blurb + KMS integration notes.
- Billing matrix: current monthly committed GPUs, observed 90-day utilization, proposed new commit.

Attaching the two files now. Happy to iterate.

Cheers,
Karthik
Director, Cloud GTM
Redwood Inference
[Attachment: Redwood_Evidence_Pack_v2.pdf (PDF, 1.2MB)]
[Attachment: Invoice_Gap_Mapping.xlsx (XLSX, 120KB)]

From: Bethany Lee <bethany.lee@nimhealth.com>

Date: Wed, 11 Jul 2028 15:42:00 +0000
Subject: Re: Marketplace renewal evidence pack & invoice gap plan

Thanks Karthik — appreciated. I skimmed the evidence pack and it looks mostly complete. Quick questions from the procurement side: 

1) Can you call out the exact invoice line we should expect for the committed capacity vs the one-time onboarding credit? Procurement needs a numerical line-item to match to our ERP (Workday).
2) Do you have a PO template that shows the final naming convention Redwood wants on the invoice? Our AP team rejects invoices that don't include the full marketplace private-offer ID.
3) Timing: our budget committee meets on 19-Jul; if we have the PO and the invoice cadence by EOD 20-Jul that should work.

I'll loop Tim (our outside counsel) separately if we need any legal redlines on the private-offer terms. For now procurement wants the invoice mapping spreadsheet populated.

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>

Date: Thu, 12 Jul 2028 10:05:00 +0000
Subject: Re: Marketplace renewal evidence pack & invoice gap plan (internal)

Karthik / Neha —

I've reviewed the Invoice_Gap_Mapping.xlsx and made three annotations: 
- Row 4 (committed capacity): split into two invoice lines — "Committed GPU hours (monthly)" and "Overage (per token)" so AP can reconcile.
- Added the private-offer ID in the PO template (PrivateOffer_PO_Draft.pdf) — see tab "PO_TEMPLATE".
- Marked the onboarding credit as a one-time invoice (code: RWD-ONB-2028) to prevent it from being treated as recurring in Workday.

I've attached an updated mapping (attached). Timelines: if Bethany can route the PO to you by 20-Jul we can have invoices aligned to the marketplace acceptance on 1-Aug. If PO slips beyond 25-Jul, we'll need to either issue a pro-rated invoice for July or accept a billing lag (customer preference).

Attaching: Invoice_Gap_Mapping_v2.xlsx

Marissa
Sales Operations
Redwood Inference

Subject: Re: Marketplace renewal evidence pack & invoice gap plan

Bethany —

Thanks for the quick reply. I've taken Marissa's updates and pulled them into a fresh evidence pack and PO draft. Key items we updated for AP: 
- Explicit invoice lines and SKU mapping for Workday.
- Private-offer ID present in both PO and invoice templates.
- One-time onboarding credit flagged with RWD-ONB-2028 code.

Next steps I can own: 1) upload the final evidence pack to your secure acceptance portal (link below), 2) send a DocuSign for the PO so procurement can route internally, 3) coordinate with billing to ensure the first invoice is pro-rated to 1-Aug if the PO is processed after 25-Jul.

DocuSign (PO): https://docusign.com/eg/12345-Redwood-PrivateOffer
Acceptance upload: https://drive.google.com/open?id=1a2B3cEvidencePack

If you want a quick 15-min ops call on Mon 16-Jul to walk procurement through the invoice lines, Marissa and Neha can join.

Regards,
